title: Fuzzing Dial
tagline: Compare how different input-generation strategies scale coverage discovery over time.

curves.label: Random Mutation
curves.code: for(attempt=0; attempt<n; attempt++){ mutant=mutate(randomSeed()); coverage |= run(mutant); }
curves.name: Random Mutation

curves.label: AFL-Style Power Schedules
curves.code: while(attempt<n){ pick=selectSeedByPower(); mutant=mutate(pick); coverage |= run(mutant); updatePower(pick, feedback); }
curves.name: AFL-Style Power Schedules

curves.label: Greybox with MAB Prioritization
curves.code: for(attempt=0; attempt<n; attempt++){ arm=ucb1(selectArms()); mutant=mutate(arm.seed); r=feedback(run(mutant)); updateUCB(arm, r); }
curves.name: Greybox with MAB Prioritization

curves.label: Symbolic Execution Bursting
curves.code: for(step=0; step<n; step++){ constraints=collectPathConstraints(); if(stagnant) splitPath(); solve(constraints); coverage |= run(model); }
curves.name: Symbolic Execution Bursting

curves.label: Hybrid Concolic Loop
curves.code: repeat n times{ concrete=mutateConcrete(); symbolic=refineWithSolver(concrete); coverage |= run(symbolicModel); adjustStrategy(feedback); }
curves.name: Hybrid Concolic Loop
